author: Ari Koslow
title: Francisco Lindor (calf) could be activated this week
desc: The Mets could activate Francisco Lindor from the injured list this week.
impact: Lindor finished 2-for-5 with two singles on Tuesday for Triple-A Syracuse in a rehab game. He played eight innings at shortstop. He is expected to re-join the Mets next where he'll be further evaluated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edward Cabrera exits early Tuesday with left hamstring/adductor strain
desc: The Cubs say Edward Cabrera left the game with a left hamstring/adductor strain.
impact: Cabrera was carted off the field during his start on Tuesday. He will continue to be further evaluated by the Cubs.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Lodolo (wrist) has X-rays return negative
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona told reporters Nick Lodolo underwent X-rays that came back negative for any fractures.
impact: Lodolo was removed from Tuesday's start after he took a comebacker off his left wrist. He is day-to-day heading into the rest of the week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Patrick Sandoval (biceps) throws 53 pitches in rehab start Tuesday
desc: Patrick Sandoval threw 53 pitches over 3 1/3 innings on Tuesday in a rehab start for Triple-A Worcester.
impact: Sandoval allowed two runs with one strikeout and one walk. He'll continue to build-up his pitch count on his rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jack Flaherty (leg) throws 83 pitches in rehab start Tuesday
desc: Jack Flaherty threw 83 pitches over 5 2/3 innings on Tuesday in a rehab start for Double-A Erie.
impact: Flaherty allowed two runs with seven strikeouts and one walk in his first rehab start. He should be making his return around the corner back in the Tigers rotation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Byron Buxton not expected to be traded by Twins
desc: Twins GM Jeremy Zoll said there are no plans to trade Byron Buxton.
impact: Buxton has a full no-trade clause and would need to approve any potential deal. The trade rumors will continue, but it appears he'll be remaining in Minnesota, at least for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Greene (elbow) works four innings in rehab start
desc: Hunter Greene threw four shutout innings in a rehab start for Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday.
impact: Greene threw 64 pitches after he was targeting 70-75 pitches. He'll likely require at least one more rehab outing.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Freddy Fermin activated from concussion IL
desc: The Padres activated C Freddy Fermin from the concussion injured list.
impact: Fermin makes his return after being sidelined the past week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Hunt optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Padres optioned C Blake Hunt to Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Hunt will return to Triple-A with Freddy Fermin activated from the concussion injured list.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Juan Soto leaves Tuesday's game with back spasm
desc: Juan Soto was pulled from Tuesday's game against the Cubs with a back spasm.
impact: Soto was originally announced to have left side back tightness, but it has been revealed to be a back spasm. Fantasy managers can breathe a sigh of relief, as the outfielder could be able to return to the field as soon as Wednesday.

author: Nate Miller
title: Kyle Schwarber (back) a late scratch Tuesday night
desc: Kyle Schwarber (back) was a late scratch from Tuesday's starting lineup.
impact: Schwarber is reportedly dealing with some lower back tightness. Edmundo Sosa moved into the lineup at DH. Schwarber should be considered day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alec Burleson enters lineup Tuesday
desc: Alec Burleson is in the Cardinals lineup on Tuesday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Burleson was originally expected to get the day off. With Masyn Winn scratched, Burleson will bat seventh and start at first base.

author: Nate Miller
title: CJ Abrams (side) out of Tuesday's lineup
desc: CJ Abrams (side) was scratched from Tuesday's starting lineup.
impact: Abrams is reportedly dealing with tightness on his left side. Nasim Nunez will slide over to shortstop while Jorbit Vivas starts at second base. Abrams should be considered day-to-day.
